The '''Silver Falcon''' was a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vulta]].<ref name="Deceived" /> In [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates the end of the [[Great Galactic War]], which was concurrent with [[Zeerid Korr]]'s trip to [[Vulta]], to [[3653 BBY]].</ref> the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Zeerid Korr]] entered and quickly exited the Silver Falcon to make sure he was not being followed while he was on his way to buy a [[Repulsorlift chair/Legends|hoverchair]] for [[Arra Yooms]], his daughter who was a paraplegic.<ref name="Deceived" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Silver Falcon appeared in the [[2011]] novel ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'', written by [[Paul S. Kemp]].<ref name="Deceived" />
